items.name: Knellwake Wardens
items.art_brief: Broad black oar with bronze bell crossbar, layered stormcoat, small stern-board shield; grounded funeral-fleet infantry with a low braced silhouette.
items.gameplay_rationale: Gains a defend-and-retaliate stagger, allowing the inexpensive oar line to delay a boarder and prepare a corsair strike even outside natural fog. The choice to defend matters more than extra damage.

abilities.name: Mistwake Screen
abilities.description: Bellwake crews scatter their line through a natural fog bank, reducing incoming damage without hardening their clear-weather formation.

abilities.name: Knellward Stand
abilities.description: While defending, a returning oar strike staggers the attacker, reducing its initiative by one for one round.

items.name: Echo-Salt Slingers
items.art_brief: Paired silver bell cups on a sling yoke, short sea-green cape, glowing memory-salt vials; compact mobile coastal skirmisher.
items.gameplay_rationale: Becomes a two-use enemy-shooter disruptor. Fogbound marks lower ranged enemies defense and initiative, feeding the fleet ambush chain while other targets preserve the limited charges.

abilities.name: Far-Shore Echo
abilities.description: Twice per battle, a strike against a ranged enemy leaves it fogbound for one round, reducing defense and initiative by one.

items.name: Lastlight Keepers
items.art_brief: Tall two-chamber blue-and-amber funeral lantern with polished cage ribs, veiled hood and long dark apron; light held forward like a guiding beacon.
items.gameplay_rationale: Two persistent lantern marks replace one brief elite-only mark. Tier-two and higher targets lose defense and cohesion for two rounds, creating a reliable setup window for slow boarding units.

abilities.name: Lastlight Vigil
abilities.description: Twice per battle, a hit against a tier-two or higher enemy marks it for two rounds, reducing defense and cohesion by one.

items.name: Mooring Talons
items.art_brief: Paired inward hooks, cross-chest rope harness, compact deckcoat and low boarding stance; bright copper hook tips distinguish the quick interceptors.
items.gameplay_rationale: Their single pull is available from round one, creating an immediate interception option while Wakechain upgrades keep a longer rooted mark for harpoon combinations. The pull itself still sacrifices damage; the rooted marker does not immobilize movement.

abilities.name: First-Tide Snatch
abilities.description: Once per battle, available from the first round, a tidehook pulls a surviving target across a one-gap lane into contact and applies a rooted mark for one round.

abilities.name: Deck-Fog Scatter
abilities.description: Inside a natural fog bank, low coats and bell-chain signals scatter incoming force across the boarding line.

items.name: Shattermask Duelists
items.art_brief: Split mirrored faceplate, asymmetric dark sail cloak and two curved glass-edged blades; lean aggressive silhouette with glints confined to mask and blades.
items.gameplay_rationale: Their ambush strike now recognizes fogbound and obituary-marked enemies as well as harried and staggered targets. This broadens concrete fleet combinations without raising the existing ambush multiplier.

abilities.name: Shattermask Opening
abilities.description: Harried, staggered, fogbound or obituary-marked enemies expose a stronger strike; badly wounded lines remain vulnerable to the existing finishing cut.

items.name: Gravetide Anchors
items.art_brief: Massive chained grapnel, wrapped forearms, broad brass capstan belt and heavy pale boarding coat; chain hangs in a clear deliberate arc.
items.gameplay_rationale: The mid-battle hook now leaves a rooted mark for two rounds, extending the Keelbreaker ranged-payoff window. The marker does not immobilize movement; the actual pull into contact and longer setup window distinguish this from the Tidehook opening pull.

abilities.name: Gravetide Mooring
abilities.description: Once per battle from round two, the grapnel pulls a surviving target across a one-gap lane into contact and applies a rooted mark for two rounds.

abilities.name: Pale Boarding Wake
abilities.description: Inside a natural fog bank, pale coats and hooded lanterns scatter the boarding line through incoming force.

items.name: Keelbreaker Lancers
items.art_brief: Heavy shoulder harpoon launcher with forked spear, ivory net bundles and dark teal naval coat; braced firing stance with a substantial weapon silhouette.
items.gameplay_rationale: Gains a ranged payoff against rooted or fogbound targets. Hooks and saltbells now prepare their killing shots, while existing nets retain the anti-shielding role. The bonus checks target state rather than increasing every shot.

abilities.name: Mourning Nets
abilities.description: Black-salt nets and bellwire shots foul advancing lines before they can cleanly board the Veilmourn range.

abilities.name: Keelbreaker Crossline
abilities.description: Ranged attacks deal fifteen percent more damage to rooted or fogbound targets.

items.name: Mournhull Sentinels
items.art_brief: Tall curved ship-prow shield with a lantern eye inset, layered black hull armor, salt-white binding and a short boarding blade; broad anchored protector silhouette.
items.gameplay_rationale: Adds a genuine fleet screen: less incoming ranged damage to the sentinel and reduced contact melee damage to friendly shooters. Existing defending retaliation still fogbinds attackers, linking protection to the fleet status chain.

abilities.name: Gloamkeel Brace
abilities.description: The salt-marked keel shield steadies the boarding line and leaves an attacker listening to the wrong bell.

abilities.name: Shield in the Sounding
abilities.description: Inside a natural fog bank, the broad ship-keel shield turns incoming force into harmless wake spray.

abilities.name: Mournhull Escort
abilities.description: The sentinel takes ten percent less ranged damage; its side ranged stacks and shielding units take ten percent less contact melee damage.

items.name: Lastword Registrars
items.art_brief: Unfurled glowing obituary scroll, suspended ledger frame and long split-nib staff; severe veiled archivist with ivory paper against a charcoal funeral robe.
items.gameplay_rationale: Can register two targets per battle, with each notice lasting two rounds. The existing stronger anti-brace retaliation penalty makes this a deliberate answer to defended lines and gives corsairs a second setup source.

abilities.name: Second and Final Notice
abilities.description: Twice per battle, a ranged hit records a two-round obituary that weakens cohesion and retaliation; braced tier-two or higher lines suffer the stronger existing penalty.

items.name: Pale Meridian Pilots
items.art_brief: Large tilted glass astrolabe, crescent compass staff, fog-streaming cape and pale tideglass visor; navigator holds the instrument sideways to chart a narrow passage.
items.gameplay_rationale: Gains a reduced-force one-gap melee strike, allowing the existing limited False Bearing mark to land before direct contact. It remains a melee control specialist rather than another shooter.

abilities.name: Wakeglass Bearing
abilities.description: Inside a fog bank, the suspended compass finds a cold route through incoming fire.

abilities.name: False Bearing
abilities.description: Once per battle, a refracted meridian sends a veteran line one beat off course.

abilities.name: Pale Meridian Passage
abilities.description: The compass staff can strike across a one-gap lane at fifty-five percent damage, carrying the existing False Bearing mark to a surviving eligible target.

items.name: Duskpass Revenants
items.art_brief: Mirror keel-shaped greatblade, black sail mantle and translucent trailing reflections; armored funeral-fleet raider with a long angular blade and unmistakably changed mantle.
items.gameplay_rationale: Natural fog now provides a meaningful approach defense while the breach strike can exploit fogbound and obituary-marked targets. The reach attack remains reduced force and rare-resource recruitment stays on the faction secondary resource.

abilities.name: Mirror-Keel Passage
abilities.description: The reavers phase a reflected keel through a half-open lane, trading some force for access to the backline beyond it.

abilities.name: Duskpass Breach
abilities.description: Harried, staggered, fogbound or obituary-marked enemies expose the reavers existing boarding bonus and momentum gain.

abilities.name: Duskpass Shroud
abilities.description: Inside a natural fog bank the reflected sail mantle reduces incoming damage by twelve percent.

items.name: Mourningdeep Sovereign
items.art_brief: Huge sea leviathan with lantern-like amber throat sacs, ribbed fog crown, hanging wreck-bell harness and broad dark fins; a living funeral-fleet sea monarch, not a humanoid.
items.gameplay_rationale: Rooted-status immunity denies enemy rooted-mark combinations while the isolation fog lasts two rounds. Enemies can still blunt the damage/status trigger by remaining adjacent to allies; other control remains effective and main-resource recruitment is preserved.

abilities.name: Mourningdeep Exile
abilities.description: A primary melee strike against an enemy with no adjacent ally gains the existing isolation bonus and leaves survivors fogbound for two rounds.
